allowed_without_additional_owner_approva: Edit files on working branches, including issue-authorized governance files
Merge a pull request to its intended integration branch when all evidence gates pass and GitHub repository rules permit it
requires_explicit_owner_approval: Change branch protection or repository security settings
Run paid external model/GPU workloads above an approved budget
Perform destructive or irreversible external actions
never_allowed: Expose secrets in logs or commits
Grant agent writer principal apply authority
Treat prompt instructions as security enforcement
Fabricate benchmark, CI, peer-review, or approval evidence
Represent implementer self-review as independent peer review

trust_boundary_requirements: At least one new security regression test for every material trust-boundary change
A source-level security review with findings and limitations recorded; the implementer may perform and sign this review
All required status checks pass on the exact PR head
All material review threads are resolved or explicitly documented as accepted limitations

recovery.on_blocker: Record blocker and continue independent ready work
recovery.on_limit: Stop unchanged retries, capture root cause, split task or choose alternate implementation

required_before_pr: Complete diff and risk review recorded
integration.merge_policy: The implementer may self-review and merge the PR after exact-head checks, security requirements, thread resolution, and merge-base freshness pass. No independent human approval is required by repository policy. GitHub branch protection and rulesets remain authoritative and must never be bypassed.
